reviews.comment: Best professor so far at A&M! You can tell he genuinely cares about his students and understands the course is difficult and tries his best to make it as painless as possible. You can tell he is very knowledgeable and passionate about accounting (which is very hard to find in this subject).
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Mr. Williams is incredible. He made ACCT 229 clear and easy to understand. He is also just a very good person and really cares about his students. He tries his best to help you succeed and you can really tell he enjoys what he does and wants you to do well. Could not recommend him more!!

One of the best profs I had at A&M. It seemed that he was just at a disadvantage coming in during his first semester not being able to create his own curriculum and exams. The other profs would only let him see the exam a few days before the day of the exam itself so he was unable to prepare us for it. NOT HIS FAULT. Take Williams!!
